rules.trigger: If stakeholder audience is below the verified minimum age
rules.recommended_action: Do not recommend without an approved adaptation; explain the mismatch
rules.guidance: A technical electronics workshop should not automatically be recommended to preschool participants

rules.trigger: If participant count exceeds maximum simultaneous capacity
rules.recommended_action: Suggest rotations, parallel stations, repeated sessions, or an alternative offering
rules.guidance: An offering for 40 sets cannot automatically serve 200 participants simultaneously

rules.trigger: If the venue has no electricity
rules.recommended_action: Exclude mains-dependent activities or recommend a verified battery-powered alternative
rules.guidance: Recommend only activities that can operate within the available infrastructure

rules.trigger: If internet availability is unknown and the activity may require it
rules.recommended_action: Ask a follow-up question or state an assumption
rules.guidance: Confirm connectivity before recommending a cloud-dependent coding activity

rules.trigger: If requested duration is shorter than setup plus delivery requirement
rules.recommended_action: Propose a simplified version, demonstration, or alternative offering
rules.guidance: Do not compress a complex build into an unrealistic duration

rules.trigger: If an activity is not validated for outdoor delivery
rules.recommended_action: Flag the limitation and ask about shelter, weather, and surface conditions
rules.guidance: Do not assume electronic kits can be used outdoors

rules.trigger: If an activity contains controlled equipment, chemicals, flame, batteries, or tools
rules.recommended_action: Apply the relevant safety restriction and trained-facilitator requirement
rules.guidance: Do not recommend participant-led handling when facilitator-only delivery is required

rules.recommended_action: Use the approved cost band and do not invent a price
rules.guidance: State that exact costing requires validation

rules.recommended_action: Ask targeted follow-up questions or state transparent assumptions
rules.guidance: Ask for audience age, participant count, venue, duration, and budget

rules.trigger: If an offering is not in the verified catalogue
rules.recommended_action: Label it as a proposed concept, not an existing offering
rules.guidance: Separate verified Petrosains offerings from AI-generated enhancements

rules.recommended_action: Ask about required accommodations and suggest flexible delivery options
